DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Heart Disease (specifically Right-to-Left Shunting lesion leading to Cor Pulmonale).

The 3-year-old age and the combination of rapid breathing, leg swelling, and an enlarged heart on X-ray strongly suggest a cyanotic congenital heart defect. I am ready to conclude the workup with a final diagnosis based on this evidence.
